about: respx, vendored unmodified for the fi.gateway unit suite: the fixed CI line (pip install -e ./python pytest) installs no respx. Every file below is byte-identical to the respx-0.23.1 wheel; the hashes are the wheel's own RECORD entries (respx/<name>, and respx-0.23.1.dist-info/LICENSE.md for LICENSE.md). python/tests/gateway/unit/test_vendored_respx.py checks them, and FI_GATEWAY_TEST_RESPX=installed runs the suite against a pip-installed respx instead.

module_line_limit_exception.reason: Unmodified third-party test dependency, not first-party SDK code. Keep upstream bytes and license intact instead of rewriting the vendor to satisfy the first-party 400-line limit. test_vendored_respx.py checks every file against the wheel RECORD; test_gw_gates.py requires this exact size exception list.
